title: Abandoned Shed
text: A rickety shed leans precariously at the edge of Willowbrook, its weathered boards creaking in the wind. Rusty tools and broken crates are scattered about a long workbench, and a thick layer of dust covers everything. Little light gets past the grimy boards, and the air smells of old earth and lamp oil.

title: Abandoned Shed, inside
text: The inside of a rickety shed at the edge of Willowbrook, in near-darkness: light comes only through thin cracks between the grimy boards. Rusty tools and broken crates are scattered about a long workbench, and a thick layer of dust covers everything. The air smells of old earth and lamp oil. No cat lies in view; at most a pair of eyes glints behind the crates.

patches.title: Broken Shovel taken
patches.text: Take the broken shovel out of the picture.

patches.title: Patches gone
patches.text: Take the eyes behind the crates out of the picture.

patches.title: Fishing Rod appears
patches.text: Add the fishing rod up on the dusty shelves.

patches.title: Magnet appears
patches.text: Add the magnet up on the dusty shelves.

title: Blacksmith's Forge
text: A hot, smoky forge. A log fire burns on the hearthstone, and not all of its smoke finds the chimney. A single horseshoe hangs on the wall. Borin stands between the fire and the anvil, his hammer in his hand, watching the fire.

patches.title: Horseshoe taken
patches.text: Remove the horseshoe from the picture.

title: Chicken Coop
text: A small wooden coop stands here, its planks patched and weathered. Nervous chickens cluck and flutter, their feathers ruffled as they dart between straw nests. The air is thick with the scent of hay and the occasional squawk. Sunbeams slip through the slats, casting striped shadows on the dirt floor. High on a rafter, out of reach, something glints where no hen could have put it.

patches.title: Egg taken
patches.text: Remove the egg from the picture.

patches.title: Feather taken
patches.text: Remove the feather from the picture.

patches.title: Key appears
patches.text: Add the key lying in the straw on the floor, where it fell.

title: Elior's Cottage
text: A modest cottage with a straw roof and a cozy hearth. The scent of fresh bread and old books fills the air. The doorway to your room stands open, and the room beyond it is too dark to see into. A sturdy wooden table sits in the center, with a small loaf cooling on it, and a gentle fire crackles in the hearth. Grandmother stands by your doorway, humming, and keeps an eye on the bread.

patches.title: Bread taken
patches.text: Remove the bread from the picture.

patches.title: Lantern lit
patches.text: Light the lantern on the table: a small warm flame in the glass.

patches.title: Lantern carried
patches.text: Lying on the lit corner: take the lantern off the table, as if Elior had it in her hand; nothing else changes.

patches.title: Patches appears
patches.text: Add Patches, a small cat with ginger, black and white patchwork fur.

patches.title: Faded Photograph appears
patches.text: Add a small faded photograph lying in an opened drawer, showing two adults and a child.

title: Forest Path
text: A winding path snakes into the heart of the woods, dappled sunlight flickering through the canopy above. Beside the path, thick, thorny vines block a small alcove. The air is alive with the scent of pine and wildflowers, and the ground is soft with moss and fallen leaves. Birds flit between branches, and the occasional snap of a twig hints at unseen creatures nearby.

patches.title: Vines cut
patches.text: Show the vines cut away from the alcove behind them.

patches.title: Stick appears
patches.text: Add the stick to the picture.

patches.title: Snare appears
patches.text: Add the snare in the alcove, with a fox kit caught in it.

patches.title: Snare cut
patches.text: Show the snare cut and empty, the fox kit gone.

patches.title: Wild Berries appears
patches.text: Add the wild berries to the picture.

title: General Store
text: A cluttered shop with the shutters half down. Rope, apples and trinkets crowd the shelves in the gloom. Hemlock stands at his counter, sorting apples, and keeps glancing at the lane to the chapel.

patches.title: Shutters raised
patches.text: Raise the window shutters all the way.

patches.title: Rope gone
patches.text: Remove the rope from the picture.

patches.title: Matches gone
patches.text: Remove the matches from the picture.

patches.title: Patches appears
patches.text: Add Patches, a small cat with ginger, black and white patchwork fur.

title: Hidden Glade
text: A hushed clearing hidden deep within the forest, dim and overgrown. Brambles crowd its edges, and the tall grass stands grey and still beneath branches that shut out the sun. In the center, a mossy stone bears a faint inscription, too deep in shadow to read. An unnatural darkness lingers here, though the sky above the branches is clear.

patches.title: Shiny Pebble taken
patches.text: Remove the shiny pebble from the picture.

patches.title: Rare Flower appears
patches.text: Add the rare flower: deep purple petals with gold at the centre, faintly glowing.

patches.title: Deer appears
patches.text: Add Deer to the picture.

title: Mira's Hut
text: A small hut hung with drying herbs: lavender, sage, and roots in bundles from the rafters. Shelves of bottles line the walls, every one labelled. Mira stands at the window with her back to you, tying a bundle of herbs in the light.

patches.title: Ancient Amulet gone
patches.text: Remove the ancient amulet from the picture.

title: Old Mill
text: A creaky windmill towers above, its sails turning slowly in the breeze. In the yard below, sacks of grain slump against a stone wall beside a heavy millstone, and the scent of flour hangs in the air. Under the lean-to by the wall, you notice a strange mechanism of black iron, whirring to itself, that doesn't belong to the mill's original design.

patches.title: Millstone Fragment appears
patches.text: Add the millstone fragment to the picture.

patches.title: Mechanism jammed
patches.text: Jam a rope through the black-iron mechanism, which hangs still.

title: Borin
text: A face portrait of a broad, bearded village smith, his cheeks flushed from the forge and a smudge of soot on his brow, with a keen, busy look.

title: Deer
text: A face portrait of a red-brown deer, its dark eyes calm and unafraid and its ears turned toward you.

title: Voice
text: A face portrait of a tall dark figure in rain-soaked shadow, with no face you can make out, only a pale blur where a face should be, like smoke.

title: Fisherman
text: A face portrait of an old man with a sun-creased face and a white stubbled beard, patient eyes, and a battered cloth cap.

title: Merchant
text: A face portrait of a travelling merchant, lean and hungry-looking, with sharp cheekbones, shrewd tired eyes and a road-worn hat.

title: Patches
text: A face portrait of a small cat with a patchwork coat of ginger, black and white, and wide green eyes.

title: Priest
text: A face portrait of a thin, slightly stooped old priest with a gentle, worried face.

title: Hemlock
text: A face portrait of an old storekeeper with a nervous, sideways glance and thinning white hair.

title: Tilda
text: A face portrait of a plump, cheerful baker’s wife with flour on her cheek, bright gossiping eyes and a headscarf.

title: Riverbank
text: A gentle river flows past the village and makes a slow bend here, past the reeds and a broad, flat stone at the water's edge. Insects hum over the water. A weathered fisherman sits on an upturned crate at the bend, watching the water.

patches.title: Mother's Letter appears
patches.text: Tip the smooth stone askew beside a hole dug in the mud, with a small open tin.

title: Road to Greendale
text: The main road out of Willowbrook runs east under old oaks, their branches meeting overhead. The way is well trodden, lined with wildflowers and fallen leaves. A merchant's cart stands at the roadside, and his thin grey mare grazes beside it on three good shoes. North of the road the land climbs onto the edge of the moor: heather, and still brown pools.

patches.title: Rusty Saw taken
patches.text: Remove the rusty saw from the picture.

title: The Dream
text: It is raining hard on a village street. Thunder breaks so close that the shutters shake with it. Shadows drift through the rain like smoke. In the street a man in a hooded cloak holds a child against his shoulder. His hood hides his face. Somewhere a slow tune climbs three notes and settles home again. Behind him a tall figure stands among the shadows. It has no face you can find. It is too far away to reach, and too close to be only a dream. It is whispering, at the very edge of hearing, and what it whispers is your name.

title: Vegetable Field
text: Rows of withered crops stretch beneath the last grey of the night's storm. The earth is cracked and dry, with only a few stubborn carrots and a rusty trowel hinting at better days. A faint breeze rustles the brittle leaves, carrying the scent of soil and distant rain. On market day these rows were green.

patches.title: Rusty Trowel taken
patches.text: Remove the rusty trowel from the picture.

patches.title: Dull Knife taken
patches.text: Remove the dull knife from the picture.

patches.title: Carrot taken
patches.text: Remove the carrot from the picture.

patches.title: Carrot freshened
patches.text: Make the carrot in the field green and fresh instead of withered.

title: Village Chapel
text: A small stone chapel at the end of the village lane. Its stained glass windows cast colours across the worn pews, and the air is cool and smells of candle wax. A kindly priest tends the altar. By the door the bell rope hangs straight and still. Above the door a faint carving, worn almost smooth, shows a tree under two moons. A dark corner by the altar swallows the light.

patches.title: Candle lit
patches.text: Light the candle on the altar: a small steady flame, and the dark corner beside it lit.

patches.title: Locket appears
patches.text: Add the locket to the picture.

title: Village Square
text: The heart of Willowbrook: cobblestones around an old stone fountain, and a weathered notice board covered in faded announcements. The market is busy, but the talk at the stalls is low, and it stops when you pass.

patches.title: Bucket taken
patches.text: Remove the bucket from the picture.

title: Village Well
text: An old stone well stands between the field and the forge, its stones worn smooth by countless hands. A narrow stone shaft drops into darkness, and the water lies far below, out of reach. Moss creeps up the sides.

patches.title: Well purified
patches.text: Make the water in the well clear and bright instead of dark and green.
